overview: The `perl-sub-name` skill focuses on the application of the `Sub::Name` module to enhance the introspective capabilities of Perl code. By default, anonymous subroutines lack a name in the symbol table, which complicates debugging and performance analysis. This tool allows you to programmatically assign a name to a code reference. This is essential for dynamic code generation, factory patterns, and complex functional programming where identifying the origin of a specific closure is critical for m
